description: Create SchoolContext, school selection page with Netflix-style card grid, access code verification modal, and session persistence via localStorage. Extend ProtectedRoute to require school selection. Add 'Ganti Sekolah' button to TopNav.
steps: Step 1: Create src/contexts/SchoolContext.jsx - a new React context that provides: selectedSchool (object with id, name or null), selectSchool(school), clearSchool(), loading state. On mount, check localStorage for 'selectedSchool' JSON. Provide these values to all children.

Step 2: Create src/pages/SchoolSelect.jsx - Netflix-style school selection page. Fetch schools from supabase 'schools' table (select id, name). Display as a responsive grid of large, touch-friendly cards (min 120px tall, rounded corners, shadow, teal accent). Each card shows the TK name prominently. When a card is clicked, show a modal/inline input asking 'Masukkan kode akses' with a simple short text input and a 'Masuk' button. On submit, query supabase: select id, name from schools where id = selectedSchool.id AND access_code = inputValue. If match, call selectSchool({id, name}), save to localStorage, and navigate to '/'. If no match, show error 'Kode akses salah'. The page should have the app logo at top, title 'Pilih Sekolah Anda', and be fully mobile-responsive.

Step 3: Create src/pages/SchoolSelect.css - styling for the school selection page. Netflix-style card grid (CSS Grid, auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr)). Cards with background gradient or solid color, large text, hover/active states with scale transform. Modal overlay for code input with centered card. Mobile-first with comfortable touch targets (min 48px tap area).

Step 4: Update src/App.jsx - Import SchoolProvider and wrap it inside AuthProvider (or alongside it). Import SchoolSelect page. Add route: '/select-school' -> SchoolSelect (public, no ProtectedRoute). Keep existing routes but wrap them with a new SchoolProtectedRoute or extend ProtectedRoute to also check school selection.

Step 5: Update src/components/ProtectedRoute.jsx - In addition to checking isTeacher, also check that selectedSchool is not null (from SchoolContext). If no school selected, redirect to '/select-school' instead of '/login'. Keep existing login check first (if not logged in, go to login; if logged in but no school, go to select-school).

Step 6: Update src/components/TopNav.jsx - Add a 'Ganti Sekolah' button next to the 'Keluar' button (only shown when a school is selected and user is authenticated). When clicked, call clearSchool() from SchoolContext (which clears localStorage) and navigate to '/select-school'. Also display the current school name as a small badge/label in the topbar.
Step 7: Update src/main.jsx - Wrap App with SchoolProvider if not done in App.jsx (preference is to add SchoolProvider in App.jsx around the routes, inside AuthProvider).

Step 8: Provide SQL migration for the 'schools' table: CREATE TABLE schools (id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL, access_code text NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); INSERT INTO schools (name, access_code) VALUES ('TK Dewi Masyithoh 69 Keting', '69'), ('TK Dewi Masyithoh 59 Jombang', '59'), ('TK DARUTTAQWA Jombang', '01'), ('TK Dewi Masyithoh 15 Keting', '15'), ('TK Dharma Wanita 02 Padomasan', '02'); Save this as supabase/migrations/001_create_schools.sql
acceptance_criteria: SchoolContext provides selectedSchool, selectSchool, clearSchool to all components
SchoolSelect page fetches school list from Supabase 'schools' table and renders as a card grid
Clicking a school card prompts for access code input
Correct code stores school in localStorage and navigates to home
Incorrect code shows error message in Indonesian
ProtectedRoute redirects to /select-school if no school is selected (but user is logged in)
TopNav shows current school name and a 'Ganti Sekolah' button that clears selection
SQL migration file exists with correct schema and seed data
npm run build succeeds without errors
verification: Run `npm run build` in /projects/sandbox/quiz-paud and confirm it succeeds
Run `npm run lint` and confirm no errors (warnings acceptable)
findings: All lint errors (36 total) are pre-existing across the codebase (unused React import, etc). My changes introduced zero new lint errors. Build passes successfully. SchoolContext uses lazy initialization via useState(getStoredSchool) instead of useEffect to avoid the react-hooks/set-state-in-effect lint rule.
